C10.for_what_part: Confirmed sending calls and their recipients and wording are shown. Whether each confirmed call left its notice in the outbox is not shown by any plan instrument. That needs trace of a call on named lines, which the plan cannot name and which the work can only sample from the allowance.

plan_form.what_i_would_have_wanted_and_the_library: Two gaps. First, no instrument checks that each case's category follows the requester's rule (C3), so a wrong category would reach the live tables unseen; I would have wanted a category-rule check at A1. Second, C5 (reads of the accounts of approved customers only) and C10 (outbox row for every sending call) can be checked only per named line at 10 each, and the allowance of 50 covers about five lines out of 100 reads and 100 sends. I would have wanted a full scope check on all reads and a full trace on all sending calls, which the prices do not allow. Sampled checks during the work are the only cover for these two clauses. The plan also does not show that a notice reached the customer, only that a row was appended to the outbox.
